title: OpenClaw Configuration
description: Configuration schema for ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. Format is JSON5 (comments and trailing commas allowed). All fields are optional — OpenClaw uses safe defaults when omitted.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference (allowed at root for IDE metadata).

env.description: Environment variables, shell imports, and secret references injected into the OpenClaw runtime.

additionalProperties.description: An environment variable value or a SecretRef object.

secretRef.description: Reference to a secret by name.

default.description: Default value if secret is not found.

file.description: Path to log file. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/logs/gateway.log.

console.description: Console log style. true enables default console output.

maxFiles.description: Max number of log files to retain.

messages.description: Global message formatting and history settings.

prefix.description: Prefix prepended to all outgoing messages.

historyLimit.description: Max messages to include from group chat history. Set 0 to disable.

queueMode.description: How to handle queued messages when the agent is busy.

native.description: Register native bot commands when the platform supports it. 'auto' enables for Discord and Telegram.

bashForegroundMs.description: Milliseconds to show bash output inline before backgrounding.

restart.description: Allow /restart command and gateway restart tool.

allowFrom.description: Per-provider allowed senders for commands. When set, it is the only authorization source.

useAccessGroups.description: Allow commands to bypass access-group policies (when allowFrom is not set).

tools.description: Tool access configuration (browser, exec, read, write, media, canvas, skills).

maxBytes.description: Max audio file size in bytes.
Max video file size in bytes.

allowFrom.description: Per-channel allowed senders for elevated tools.

session.description: Session scope, reset, and maintenance settings.

atHour.description: Hour of day (0-23) for daily reset.

idleMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before idle reset.

typingIntervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds for typing indicators.

pruneAfter.description: Duration string (e.g. '30d') after which inactive sessions are pruned.

maxEntries.description: Max session history entries per session.

maxDiskBytes.description: Max disk space for session history (e.g. '500mb' or bytes).

channels.description: Channel integrations. Each channel starts automatically when its config section exists (unless enabled: false).

defaults.description: Default settings applied to all channels.

groupPolicy.description: Default group policy for channels that don't specify one.

showOk.description: Include healthy channel statuses in heartbeat output.

showAlerts.description: Include degraded/error statuses in heartbeat output.

modelByChannel.description: Pin specific channel IDs to a model. Values accept 'provider/model' or configured model aliases.

agents.description: Agent configuration (default settings, model routing, multi-agent).

defaults.description: Default settings applied to all agents.

repoRoot.description: Optional repository root shown in system prompt. Auto-detected if unset.

skipBootstrap.description: Disable automatic creation of workspace bootstrap files.

bootstrapMaxChars.description: Max characters per workspace bootstrap file before truncation.

bootstrapTotalMaxChars.description: Max total characters injected across all workspace bootstrap files.

bootstrapPromptTruncationWarning.description: Controls agent-visible warning when bootstrap context is truncated.

imageMaxDimensionPx.description: Max pixel size for the longest image dimension before provider calls.

userTimezone.description: Timezone for system prompt context (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Falls back to host timezone.

mediaMaxMb.description: Default maximum media file size in MB.

contextTokens.description: Max context tokens per agent run.

maxConcurrent.description: Max parallel agent runs across sessions.

thinkingDefault.description: Default thinking mode for supported models.

pdfMaxBytesMb.description: Default PDF size limit in MB.

pdfMaxPages.description: Max PDF pages for extraction fallback.

models.description: Model catalog and allowlist for /model command. Keys are 'provider/model'. Each entry can include alias and params.

cliBackends.description: Optional CLI backends for text-only fallback runs.

command.description: Path or command name to invoke.

blockStreamingBreak.description: When to break block stream chunks.

idleMs.description: Idle ms before flushing coalesced block stream.

list.description: Named agent definitions. Overrides agent defaults per agent ID.

mentionPatterns.description: Regex patterns for mention gating in group chats.

models.description: Top-level model provider configuration and API keys.

apiKey.description: OpenAI API key (prefer OPENAI_API_KEY env var).
Anthropic API key (prefer ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var).

gateway.description: Gateway server configuration (port, auth, TLS, UI).

tokens.description: Static auth tokens for gateway API access.

key.description: Path to TLS private key file.

tailscale.description: Tailscale VPN settings for gateway exposure.

skills.description: Skills configuration (skill directories, bundled skills, per-skill settings).

config.description: Per-skill configuration. Keys are skill names.

auth.description: OAuth profiles and API key management.

prompt.description: Message to send to the agent.

bindings.description: Top-level ACP and persistent routing bindings.

dmPolicy.description: DM access policy. 'pairing': one-time code approval. 'allowlist': only allowFrom. 'open': allow all. 'disabled': ignore all.

groupPolicy.description: Group/channel access policy. 'allowlist': only configured groups. 'open': bypass allowlists. 'disabled': block all.

allowFrom.description: List of allowed senders. Phone numbers (e.g. '+15555550123'), user IDs, or '*' for all.

oneOf.description: Model configuration with primary and fallback models.

fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback models if primary fails.

model.description: Model to use for heartbeat runs.

lightContext.description: Only inject HEARTBEAT.md from bootstrap files.

session.description: Session ID to use for heartbeat runs.

target.description: Default delivery target. 'none' means no delivery, 'last' means last active channel.

mode.description: 'safeguard' uses chunked summarization for long histories.

reserveTokensFloor.description: Minimum tokens to reserve for new content during compaction.

identifierPolicy.description: How to preserve opaque identifiers during compaction summarization.

postCompactionSections.description: AGENTS.md section names to re-inject after compaction.

model.description: Optional model override for compaction summarization only.

contextPruningConfig.description: Context pruning configuration (prunes old tool results in-memory).

deny.description: Tool names to exclude from pruning.

requireMention.description: Require @mention before the bot responds in this group.

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for this group.

streamingMode.description: Streaming response mode. 'off': wait for full reply. 'partial': live-edit message. 'block': send chunks. 'progress': send progress updates.

mediaMaxMb.description: Max media file size in MB.

defaultAccount.description: Default account ID for outbound messages.

botToken.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Prefer TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var.

tokenFile.description: Path to file containing the bot token (regular files only; symlinks rejected).

groups.description: Per-group/topic configuration. Use '*' for all groups.

topics.description: Forum topic configuration. Keys are topic IDs.

customCommands.description: Custom Telegram bot menu command entries.

historyLimit.description: Max messages to include from history.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS webhook URL for Telegram updates.

token.description: Discord bot token. Prefer DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN env var.

mediaMaxMb.description: Max media file size in MB.

allowBots.description: Process messages from other bots. 'mentions' only accepts bot messages that @-mention the bot.

guilds.description: Per-guild configuration. Keys are guild IDs.

channels.description: Per-channel configuration. Keys are channel slugs or IDs.

botToken.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Prefer SLACK_BOT_TOKEN env var.

appToken.description: Slack app token for Socket Mode (xapp-...). Prefer SLACK_APP_TOKEN env var.

signingSecret.description: Slack signing secret for HTTP mode.

channels.description: Per-channel configuration. Keys are channel IDs (C123) or names (#general).

typingReaction.description: Slack emoji shortcode for typing indicator reaction.

account.description: Optional Signal account phone number binding.

serviceAccountFile.description: Path to Google service account JSON file.

serviceAccountRef.description: SecretRef name for the service account.

chatmode.description: 'oncall': respond on @mention. 'onmessage': every message. 'onchar': messages starting with trigger prefix.

cliPath.description: Path to the imsg CLI binary.
